people.name: Francis Doyle
people.role: a photographer for the rotogravure section

secret.description: Francis Doyle drinks alone in the Bar from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

people.name: Jacob Weisglass
people.role: a stringer for the evening papers

secret.description: Jacob Weisglass is with Vincenzo Vitale in the Service Stairs from 9:30 PM to 10:30 PM, and both will say they were somewhere else.
Agnes Kavanagh is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

people.name: Emilio Ruggiero

secret.description: Emilio Ruggiero is alone with Wilhelm Vogel in the Roof Garden from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and kills Wilhelm Vogel at 9:00 PM.

coverSecret.description: Emilio Ruggiero hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Service Stairs at 8:00 PM.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

method.name: a push from the roof garden

Wilhelm Vogel was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 8:30 PM and 9:00 PM. Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.
The roof door key is missing from the Front Desk. The roof door was found unlocked and the key is not on its hook.
Rain began at 10:00 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
The passenger elevator was out of order from 7:00 PM to 7:30 PM. Anyone changing floors in that time used the service stairs.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Emilio Ruggiero's sleeve; Emilio Ruggiero was on the stairs at 7:30 PM.
Agnes Kavanagh's papers do not hold up. A steamship ticket stub in the name of a man who died at Belleau Wood.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A subpoena naming Wilhelm Vogel as a witness before the grand jury, with Rachel Abramowitz's name written in the margin.
Marion Coffin says Wilhelm Vogel said to Rachel Abramowitz that a man who testifies sleeps better.
Found in the Front Desk: A draft codicil in Wilhelm Vogel's hand striking Francis Doyle out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Marion Coffin says Wilhelm Vogel told Francis Doyle the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
Found in the Front Desk: Three letters in Wilhelm Vogel's hand to a woman Jacob Weisglass is engaged to, kept in the drawer, the last one opened.
Agnes Kavanagh says Jacob Weisglass told Wilhelm Vogel to keep away, loud enough to turn heads.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A lease assignment made out in Emilio Ruggiero's name, waiting only on Wilhelm Vogel's signature.
Chandler Havemeyer says Wilhelm Vogel told Emilio Ruggiero the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
